'''Upper Sundari Outpost''' was a military installation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] located in the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Among personnel stationed there were Agent [[Jaylla Noh]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dealk]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Hunt]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Garik (major)|Garik]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jojames]].
